name: stable-protocol
description: Governance-owned stable-asset protocol with vault issuance, oracle pricing, savings fee routing, liquidations, and a peg stability module.
use_case: Use Xian as the authoritative state and governance layer for a full stable-asset protocol while keeping deployment, operator workflows, and downstream dashboards explicit and inspectable.

starter_flows.name: local
starter_flows.summary: Run the stable protocol locally with indexed reads, the canonical bootstrap script, sample collateral and reserve tokens, and a usable default vault type.

steps.title: Create and start the local indexed node
commands: uv run xian network create stable-protocol-local --template single-node-indexed --chain-id stable-protocol-local-1 --generate-validator-key --init-node
uv run xian node start validator-1
uv run xian node endpoints validator-1
notes: Run these commands from the xian-cli checkout.
Use the reported RPC and dashboard URLs as the authoritative local endpoints for protocol bootstrap and inspection.

steps.title: Bootstrap the protocol contracts and wiring
notes: Run these commands from the xian-stable-protocol checkout.
The bootstrap script deploys the core protocol, deploys sample collateral/reserve tokens by default, configures the oracle, and seeds the default vault type.

steps.title: Start governance handoff when the bootstrap state looks correct
notes: Run this from the xian-stable-protocol checkout after verifying controllers, oracle state, fee routing, and the default vault type.
This only starts transfer to the chain governance contract. Acceptance still happens through governance proposals.

starter_flows.name: remote
starter_flows.summary: Deploy the stable protocol on a small shared network, then bootstrap the protocol core against the deployed RPC with the same canonical script.

steps.title: Create the shared-network bundle
commands: uv run xian network create stable-protocol-remote --template consortium-3 --chain-id stable-protocol-remote-1 --generate-validator-key
notes: Run this command from the xian-cli checkout.
The consortium template is the intended remote operator posture for a governance-owned stable protocol.

steps.title: Deploy validators and the service node
notes: Run these commands from the xian-deploy checkout with your validator and service-node inventory.
Use the service node for BDS-backed inspection, monitoring, and any protocol-side automation that is not supposed to run on validators.

steps.title: Bootstrap the protocol core against the deployed network
notes: Run these commands from the xian-stable-protocol checkout with XIAN_NODE_URL, XIAN_CHAIN_ID, and XIAN_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY set for the remote network.
Use --skip-sample-tokens when the collateral and reserve token contracts already exist and only the protocol core needs deployment.

steps.title: Start governance handoff after verification
notes: Run this from the xian-stable-protocol checkout after verifying the remote bootstrap state.
Transfer acceptance still happens through ordinary governance proposals on the network.
